readiness_scope: DEMO / local-mock / sandbox unless an item states otherwise. Not production-live, not customer-ready, not global demo-ready.
narrative_vs_proof: Blogs and narrative-context are narrative_context only. This file states assurance level — not penetration-test results.

maturity_legend.WIRED: Code or configuration exists on supported paths; behavior not fully validated.
maturity_legend.AUTOMATED_TESTED: Unit, integration, validator, or mock-harness evidence exists — not full public e2e.
maturity_legend.E2E_VALIDATED: Documented end-to-end journey or live gate passed in stated scope only.
maturity_legend.NOT_E2E_VALIDATED: Some automated or mock proof; no acceptable public e2e proof in current scope.
maturity_legend.BACKLOG: Tracked post-V1 hardening — not shipped as a guarantee.
maturity_legend.NOT_CLAIMED: Explicitly out of scope or forbidden to claim publicly.

field_legend.helps_prevent: Meaningfully reduces likelihood or impact when maturity is AUTOMATED_TESTED or E2E_VALIDATED.
field_legend.helps_detect: Surfaces, logs, or deduplicates issues — does not imply prevention.
field_legend.validation_level: How far assurance goes today (no internal paths).
field_legend.next_validation: Next step when NOT_E2E_VALIDATED or BACKLOG.
